_comment: Hand-minimized from the counterexample found by TestPropertyEmptyClusterBound on 2026-07-04 (rapid reported the failure flaky, so automatic shrinking was unavailable; the auto-saved shrink attempts land in failing-empty-cluster-bound.json). Scenario class: a single required zone-affinity pod (self-selecting group) on an empty cluster with unequal zone prices. The bootstrap path of TopologyGroup.nextDomainAffinity (pkg/controllers/provisioning/scheduling/topologygroup.go, 'pick a domain at random') anchors the affinity group to an arbitrary zone via randomized Go map iteration, so the greenfield and full-simulation legs can anchor to DIFFERENT zones on the same run and the incumbent can exceed the full-sim cost (observed 3.0 vs 2.0 on this fixture). Reproduces on roughly 1 in 5 runs; the invariant .2 empty-cluster bound only holds per-run if domain tie-breaking is deterministic or price-aware.
